'''Heinrich Klaus Peter Ursprung''' (13 March 1932 – 17 February 2024) was a Swiss biologist and scientific director. He was president of [[ETH Zurich]] and of [[ETH Domain]] and served as [[State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation|Secretary of State for Education, Research, and Innovation]].

==Biography==
Born in [[Bad Zurzach]] on 13 March 1932, Ursprung graduated from the [[Old Cantonal School Aarau]] in 1952 and from the [[University of Zurich]] in 1956. He lived in the United States from 1961 to 1969 and was an assistant researcher and adjunct professor at [[Johns Hopkins University]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ethistory.ethz.ch/rueckblicke/hochschulgremien/alumni/weitere_seiten/4_5_ursprung/popupfriendly/|title=Heinrich Ursprung|work=ETHistory|language=German}}</ref> In 1969, he became a professor of zoology at [[ETH Zurich]] and served as the university's president from 1973 to 1987. From 1987 to 1990, he was president of the ''Schweizerischen Schulrates''. In 1992, he was placed in charge of the State Secretariat for Education, Research, and Innovation under the umbrella of the [[Federal Department of Home Affairs]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ethz.ch/de/die-eth-zuerich/organisation/who-is-who/emeritierte-professorinnen-und-professoren/details.MTI0ODYz.TGlzdC80MDEsMTk1NzY4MzcwOQ==.html|title=Prof. em. Dr. Heinrich Ursprung|work=ETH Zurich|language=German}}</ref>

Heinrich Ursprung died on 17 February 2024, at the age of 91.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hommages.ch/fr/avis-de-deces/heinrich-peter-klaus-ursprung-ammann|title=Heinrich Peter Klaus Ursprung-Ammann|work=hommages.ch|language=French}}</ref>

==Honors==
*Member of the [[Imperial College, London]]
*Honorary doctorate from the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology]]
*Honorary doctorate from [[Lund University]]
*Honorary member of the {{ill|Swiss Academy of Engineering Sciences|fr|Académie suisse des sciences techniques}}
*Winner of the [[Wilhelm Exner Medal]] (1996)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wilhelmexner.org/medalists/heinrich-klaus-peter-ursprung/|title=Heinrich Klaus Peter Ursprung|work=Wilhelm Exner Medal|language=German}}</ref>
*Grand Star of the [[Decoration of Honour for Services to the Republic of Austria]] (1999)<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=23 April 2012|title=Dieser Text wurde elektronisch übermittelt. Abweichungen vom Original sind möglich.|trans-title= |url=https://www.parlament.gv.at/dokument/XXIV/AB/10542/imfname_251156.pdf|language=German|work=[[Austrian Parliament]]|location=Vienna|access-date=21 February 2024}}</ref>
